items.html: *The matter is that when it arose in the will of the upper Emanator to emanate Atzilut with the Upper Land, the first kings went out at first in the secret of complete judgment within the upper thought, as it is written, ‘And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom,’ and among them the Klipot and unholy judgments were mixed in. And from the abundance of judgments, the earth was nullified — that is, Malchut — until the root of the judgments struck like a hammer striking an anvil, and sparks fly out in every direction. So too the root of the judgments divided these kings into three hundred and twenty sparks, in the secret of the thirty-two paths, each one including ten. And from these sparks he clarified the sparks of holy judgment, which are the thirty-two [names of] Elohim in the account of Creation, on the side of holy judgment.
